messages.author: f24b6672b86b41b4
messages.subject: workflowr 1.1.1 released on CRAN
parts:
Hi all,

workflowr 1.1.1 has been released on CRAN.  It includes some minor new features, improved error handling, and bug fixes. Critically, it makes workflowr compatible with the latest release of git2r.

The most noticeable changes are 1) `wflow_publish()`/`wflow_status()` are now much faster, especially if your project has many R Markdown files and/or many Git commits, 2) the rmarkdown package is no longer loaded automatically when you load workflowr, and 3) the new function `wflow_open()` (based on a previous version in workflowrBeta) to open new or existing R Markdown files.

Please see the release notes for versions 1.1.1 and 1.1.0 for the all the recent updates.

John
